notes: Gem catalog, priced with the Power Level system's SOCKET/GEM rules
(src/engine/balance.ts, docs/power-level-reference.md "Socket / Gem PL
accounting"). Each gem's OWN PL must land EXACTLY on its rarity's band
(BUDGET_TOLERANCE_DECI = 0, same zero tolerance as the card audit — user-
locked 2026-07-19): Common 2 · Rare 4 · Epic 6 · Legendary 8 — checked by
`isGemOnBudget` (see tests/engine/gemAudit.test.ts). Gem PL is uncapped
bonus power stacked on top of a card's authored (tier-budgeted) kit; it is
NEVER folded into the base-card audit.
`GemDef` is display data layered on the engine's structural `Gem` type —
`name`/`text` aren't consumed by the engine, only by content/UI.

def.name: Resonant Echo
def.text: Echo: this card's attack repeats at half strength as a separate hit, and the card is 25% heavier.
notes: REPLACE (gem ruleset v1 §6/§10, 2026-08-09): was soul_rend_echo, a flat
"+16 damage" chip (retired — one of the 9 flat-damage duplicates the
migration removed). This NEW id is THE Echo: the one gem in the catalog
whose hit is `statStrike` + `echoHostPower` — proportional to whichever
card it is socketed into (half the host's own flat base + half the
caster's scaling stat), so it never needs a per-skill reskin the way the
old flat "echo" chips did (§6.1, "one per skill" is obsolete).
PRICE (host-blind, `isGemOnBudget`/the shop): actionsPriceDeci charges
an uncapped statStrike 0 (unbounded value, no honest flat rate) + the
extraHitPremium (30, one appended hit) + the echoRepeatDeci stand-in
(floor(100/2) = 50) = 80 deci = Legendary EXACTLY — the only shareOf
that lands on a band (see PRICE.echoRepeatDeci in balance.ts).
weightIncreasePct 25 is the shipped default tempo cost (§6.2's one
PL-free tuning dial): the socketed card hits harder AND comes out later.

def.name: Tremor Sliver
def.text: {{Splash}} +4 weight on the card the enemy is about to play and the ones either side of it.
notes: Entry rung (2026-08-18). PRICE: splash is 5 deci per weight
(PRICE.splashPerWeightNum/Den - 2x the slow rate: the tax lands on a
BAND of board pieces instead of on the unit's next action, and the band's
guaranteed floor is 2 pieces on any board holding more than one card.
Re-derived 2026-08-19 when the anchor stopped wrapping; the rate did not
move, so no weight here changed).
4 x 5 = 20 deci = Common EXACTLY. Minimal for its band: weight 3
prices at 15, which is no band at all.
Ladders with fracture_sliver (Rare, weight 8) on the same DOUBLING shape
the slow gems use (8 / 16 / 32) - at half the weights, since splash costs
twice as much per point. Epic and Legendary rungs would land exactly at
weight 12 (60) and weight 16 (80); deliberately NOT shipped yet - splash
has one card and no play data, and a +16 tax on up to three of a victim's
cards is the heaviest board disruption in the game. Those rungs are
balance-designer's to open.
NOT usable to make a splash AoE or to double an existing one: the splash
gate in resolveEffectiveSkill (src/engine/cards.ts) drops this action on a
host that already hits more than one target, and on a host that already
carries a splash of its own (the host's own splash always wins).

def.name: Sanctuary Sliver
def.text: {{Ward}} 1 — prevent the next ailment outright · +5% ARMOR (2 turns).
notes: NEW (balance-designer, 2026-08-18) — gap-analysis item B. `ward` alone
has no single-action band landing (charges * 50 = 50/100/150, none of
20/40/60/80), but a MULTI-ACTION gem is structurally legal (`GEM_ACTION_
PHASE` in cards.ts is exhaustive over every Action kind including ward,
and validateGemContent.ts's actions array has no length cap) — so a
companion action closes the gap instead: ward 1 (50) + buffStat armor
5%x2t (5*2*1 = 10) = 60 deci = Epic exactly. Companion chosen for theme,
not filler: a small lingering resilience buff reads as part of the same
protective ward, not an unrelated bolt-on. Minimal-magnitude clean —
ward's charges floor at 1 (no smaller variant exists) and buffStat's
pct/turns each strictly lower the total if decreased alone.

def.name: Renewal Sliver
def.text: Remove up to 1 of your ailments · Restore 3 HP.
notes: NEW (balance-designer, 2026-08-18) — gap-analysis item B. `cleanse` alone
has no single-action band landing (charges * 25 = 25/50/75/100, none of
20/40/60/80) and used to be hard-banned on any gem via UNPRICEABLE_KINDS
— that ban is lifted (see validateGemContent.ts) because a companion
closes the gap: cleanse 1 (25) + heal 3 physical (3*5 = 15) = 40 deci =
Rare exactly. heal is the self-repair companion cleanse already pairs
with on a shipped cleanse CARD (`purge_the_rot`: cleanse 4 + heal 28),
so this is the same pairing the card catalog already establishes, not a
new combination invented for the gem. Minimal-magnitude clean — both
charges and power floor at values where any smaller variant prices
under 40.

def.name: Provoker's Sliver
def.text: Gain 2 aggro (permanent) — whoever holds the most is the default target.
notes: NEW (balance-designer, 2026-08-18) — gap-analysis item C. `taunt` was a
KNOWN SILENT ZERO (price: [], no card or gem could ever be authored with
it). Now priced at tauntPerPoint = 10 deci/point (parity with `thorns`'
dotPerStack — see PRICE.tauntPerPoint in balance.ts for the full
derivation); 2*10 = 20 deci = Common exactly. No shipped card carries
`taunt` today, so this rate change and this gem both land with zero
cascade to the card catalog.

def.name: Taunting Sliver
def.text: Gain 4 aggro (permanent) — whoever holds the most is the default target.
notes: NEW (content-designer, 2026-08-19) — closes an adversarial-audit find
on the 2026-08-19 event batch: `the_lapidary`'s `warding_cut` choice
filters gemChoice on `{actionKinds: ['ward','cleanse','taunt']}`, which
matched EXACTLY 3 gems (sanctuary_sliver, renewal_sliver,
provoker_sliver) — one gem-retirement or reclassification away from
tripping `gemChoiceOutcome`'s narrower-than-EVENT_CHOICE_SIZE throw.
This is rung 2 of the taunt ladder provoker_sliver (rung 1, common,
amount 2) opened: amount 4 * tauntPerPoint (10, see PRICE.tauntPerPoint
in balance.ts) = 40 deci = Rare exactly, laddering the same way the
expose ladder already does (vulnerability_sliver -> weak_point_sliver
-> exposed_nerve_sliver -> raw_nerve_sliver). amount 3 (30 deci) lands
on no band at BUDGET_TOLERANCE_DECI = 0, so 4 is the minimal integer
that clears Rare — no floor twin, and no mechanical twin of
provoker_sliver since the payload (amount) and rarity both differ.
Widens the_lapidary's warding_cut pool from 3 to 4, and its own lint
from >=3 to >=4 (tests/run/events.test.ts). Curated into the Bulwark
themed shop list (shopTypes.ts) alongside provoker_sliver — same
aggro-holding tank identity, per that list's own comment.
